en.topic: Review: noun phrases, adverbials, speech and apostrophes

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word is a fronted adverbial in this sentence? "Later that day, the children went swimming."
questions.hint: It comes at the front and tells us when.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Where does the comma go after a fronted adverbial?
options: At the end of the sentence

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence is punctuated correctly?
options: As quick as a flash, the cat jumped.
As quick as a flash the cat, jumped.
As quick, as a flash the cat jumped.
questions.answer: As quick as a flash, the cat jumped.
